title: Book snapshot wire format
description: L2 order book snapshot as served by order-book-builder (S2) to downstream consumers (S3, S5, S8, S9-via-S6, S14-via-S6). Defined in CONVENTIONS.md §4; serialized by obb.models.OrderBook.to_snapshot_dict (price levels truncated to the requested depth per side).

bids.description: Bid side, best price first (descending price), truncated to the requested depth.

asks.description: Ask side, best price first (ascending price), truncated to the requested depth.

msgs.description: Total quote messages applied to this book since build.

rebuilds.description: Number of times this book was rebuilt from a snapshot.

bb_px.description: Best bid price (0 when the bid side is empty).

ba_px.description: Best ask price (0 when the ask side is empty).

mid.description: Mid price = (best bid + best ask) / 2 (0 when either side is empty).

spread.description: Best ask - best bid (0 when either side is empty).

imb.description: Top-level imbalance ratio = best bid qty / best ask qty (best-level quantities only), rounded to 6 decimals; 1.0 when either side is empty.

ts.description: Timestamp of this view, int64 ns since epoch.
